patches.summary: d2d1: NEUTRON_D2D_RECTLOG -- log where each distinct fill/stroke/clip/layer/bitmap lands
patches.reason: Useful for targeted private rendering/lock investigations; diagnostic collection is not a production correctness fix. Thread suspension needs its own safety/performance checks.

patches.summary: winewayland: a non-topmost click-through owned window stacks with its owner
patches.reason: Relevant to modal/overlay ordering, but depends on Neutron-specific role promotion, topmost and z-order machinery absent from this stack. Preserve the existing PBI owner/transient rules; reproduce overlap and nested-dialog behavior first.

patches.summary: winewayland: owned overlays stack in Win32 order (Lightroom first-run help froze the app)
patches.reason: Relevant to modal/overlay ordering, but depends on Neutron-specific role promotion, topmost and z-order machinery absent from this stack. Preserve the existing PBI owner/transient rules; reproduce overlap and nested-dialog behavior first.

patches.summary: winewayland: drag-and-drop and the clipboard on compositors with data-control (Hyprland crash)
patches.reason: Depends on data-control compositor support and addresses Hyprland clipboard/DND; current target is the documented Fedora native Wayland stack. Reassess for a supported compositor reproducer.

patches.summary: winewayland: restack every client subsurface, not just the first 64 windows' (Lightroom Develop tips)
patches.reason: Fixes Neutron phase-A/B restacking or its 64-window scan/cache; that implementation is not present here. Do not introduce its complete stacking subsystem solely to take the follow-up optimization.

patches.summary: kernel32: add UnregisterApplicationRecoveryCallback (Lightroom's relaunch showed a crash dialog)
patches.reason: General API/UI behavior is potentially useful, but no corresponding Power BI failure was reproduced. Requires focused native controls plus actual Desktop regression before adoption.

patches.summary: user32: readable text in standard controls under a dark palette (Lightroom About box)
patches.reason: General API/UI behavior is potentially useful, but no corresponding Power BI failure was reproduced. Requires focused native controls plus actual Desktop regression before adoption.

patches.summary: D2d1: unwrite a layer's stencil mask where it was written (Lightroom Navigator cut-off)
patches.reason: Changes a Direct2D layer path with Neutron-specific surrounding code. A Power BI clip/layer reproducer and Wine 11.18 port are required.

patches.summary: Winewayland: take a remapped control key's VK from its keysym (Hyprland caps:swapescape)
patches.reason: Depends on data-control compositor support and addresses Hyprland clipboard/DND; current target is the documented Fedora native Wayland stack. Reassess for a supported compositor reproducer.

patches.summary: Windows.media.playback.mediaplayer: MediaSource, AdaptiveMediaSource statics, a working MediaPlayer (Lightroom help videos)
patches.reason: Adds Adobe video/help playback, audio capture/device names or OpenCL compute. These are not demonstrated Power BI failures and add unrelated API surface.

patches.summary: dcomp, winewayland.drv: show CEP panels hosted in a plain app window (Audition Learn panel)
patches.reason: Relaxes Adobe CEP host recognition; Power BI deliberately selects its own WebView2 owner process and HWND. Importing this host heuristic could target the wrong surface.

patches.summary: ntdll, kernelbase: start threads with NT_TIB.Version = 0x1e00; track fibers by HasFiberData
patches.reason: Wine 11.18 already initializes native/WoW64 TIB to 0x1e00 and tests HasFiberData; ConvertFiberToThread still resets FiberData to NULL. Do not replay the full older patch or infer this is the PBIP cache failure.

patches.summary: winhttp: run a request synchronously when no status callback is installed (Adobe Help, Neutron#13)
patches.reason: WinHTTP no-callback synchronous fallback could affect authentication/networking, but upstream Windows parity is inferred. Current browser sign-in works; require local HTTP tests with callback/no-callback and auth regression.

patches.summary: winewayland.drv: present a popup larger than the screen where the app put it, unstretched (Animate first launch)
patches.reason: Potentially relevant to oversized Options/dropdowns; depends on Neutron popup placement. Reproduce with our modal/popup driver instead of replacing its current rules.

patches.summary: win32u: readable text in owner-drawn menu items under a dark palette (InDesign font menu)
patches.reason: General API/UI behavior is potentially useful, but no corresponding Power BI failure was reproduced. Requires focused native controls plus actual Desktop regression before adoption.

patches.summary: ntdll: honor <probing privatePath> in a module's application configuration file (After Effects' Mocha plug-in)
patches.reason: Native activation-context privatePath probing may help native plugins, but is distinct from CLR assembly resolution and registered database providers. Needs a synthetic side-by-side manifest fixture.

patches.summary: winmm: give waveIn a 1 s capture buffer so short app stalls don't lose audio (Premiere voice-over)
patches.reason: Adds Adobe video/help playback, audio capture/device names or OpenCL compute. These are not demonstrated Power BI failures and add unrelated API surface.

patches.summary: dwrite: key cached glyph bitmaps by rendering mode (After Effects crash while scrubbing)
patches.reason: Wine 11.18 still keys bitmap cache entries without rendering mode and copies cached size into the requested buffer. A bounded port preserves transformed-glyph cache bypass. Patch applies/reverses with zero fuzz; compilation and native bitmap/heap regression remain pending.

patches.summary: d2d1, dwrite: rasterize glyph runs only where they can be seen (After Effects crash on expression errors)
patches.reason: Current Direct2D command recording retains buffer-relative pointers across growth; clipping/size checks also matter for malformed/oversized runs. Needs a Wine 11.18 port and native command-stream/render comparison; not proof of a current Power BI crash.

patches.summary: d2d1: recorded commands keep offsets, not pointers, into the command buffer (After Effects garbled text)
patches.reason: Current Direct2D command recording retains buffer-relative pointers across growth; clipping/size checks also matter for malformed/oversized runs. Needs a Wine 11.18 port and native command-stream/render comparison; not proof of a current Power BI crash.

patches.reason: Shared-memory USER/window-tree and DPI lookup optimizations touch server/client structures, synchronization and handle lifetimes. Need a consistent full runtime and cross-process/handle-reuse tests; no cherry-picking individual structures.

patches.reason: Honoring NOACTIVATE clicks can preserve active-window/capture state, but depends on an earlier Neutron helper. Requires popup/drag tests and no lost normal activation.

patches.summary: win32u: mouse tracking follows the capture window, so a captured drag gets no WM_MOUSELEAVE
patches.reason: Tracking the capture HWND can prevent premature WM_MOUSELEAVE during drags. Upstream patch applies/reverses to our Wine source with zero fuzz; compositor drag/release behavior and native regression remain pending.

patches.summary: user32: answer IsWindow, GetParent, GetWindow, GetWindowLong and GetWindowThreadProcessId from shared memory
patches.reason: Shared-memory USER/window-tree and DPI lookup optimizations touch server/client structures, synchronization and handle lifetimes. Need a consistent full runtime and cross-process/handle-reuse tests; no cherry-picking individual structures.

patches.summary: win32u: copy a resized window's old contents into its new surface before the first flush
patches.reason: Copying old surface contents before shape flush can remove an observable blank frame on resize. Applies cleanly but needs layered/plain resize pixel evidence, not a changed fill color.

patches.summary: win32u: when a child window moves, copy only what was visible before and after, as Windows does
patches.reason: Surface move/copy and resize-hold/subtree optimizations affect invalidation and visible pixels. Dependencies differ; use overlapping-row and grow/shrink fixtures before adoption.

patches.summary: win32u: compute a child window's monitor DPI at its top-level window once; check the last session block lock-free
patches.reason: Shared-memory USER/window-tree and DPI lookup optimizations touch server/client structures, synchronization and handle lifetimes. Need a consistent full runtime and cross-process/handle-reuse tests; no cherry-picking individual structures.

patches.reason: Addresses KWin 6.8 interpreting XRGB spare byte as alpha in Neutron alpha conversion. This file/context differs and current target was validated on GNOME; require KWin-specific frame evidence.

patches.summary: --- a/dlls/win32u/window.c
patches.reason: Surface move/copy and resize-hold/subtree optimizations affect invalidation and visible pixels. Dependencies differ; use overlapping-row and grow/shrink fixtures before adoption.

patches.summary: --- a/dlls/win32u/dce.c
patches.reason: Surface move/copy and resize-hold/subtree optimizations affect invalidation and visible pixels. Dependencies differ; use overlapping-row and grow/shrink fixtures before adoption.

patches.summary: --- a/dlls/d2d1/wic_render_target.c
patches.reason: Depends on Neutron WIC GPU interfaces, pooled render targets and generation counters absent here. Its measured video-timeline gain cannot be transferred to WebView2 or imported blindly.

patches.summary: --- a/dlls/advapi32/advapi32.spec
patches.reason: Makes transacted registry writes immediate without rollback semantics. No Power BI installer failure requires that compromise; do not silently alter transactional behavior.

patches.summary: shell32: IShellItemImageFactory::GetImage fails a thumbnail-only request (LrC card thumbnails)
patches.reason: General API/UI behavior is potentially useful, but no corresponding Power BI failure was reproduced. Requires focused native controls plus actual Desktop regression before adoption.

patches.summary: ntdll: on the first critical-section timeout, log every thread's stack (hang report)
patches.reason: Useful for targeted private rendering/lock investigations; diagnostic collection is not a production correctness fix. Thread suspension needs its own safety/performance checks.

patches.summary: winewayland: an app's main window is never a subsurface of the window under its corner (GitHub Neutron#28)
patches.reason: Relevant to modal/overlay ordering, but depends on Neutron-specific role promotion, topmost and z-order machinery absent from this stack. Preserve the existing PBI owner/transient rules; reproduce overlap and nested-dialog behavior first.

external_decisions.reason: DXVK 3.1 still returns E_NOTIMPL for Get/SetBackgroundColor. No PBI caller failure reproduced. Upstream check also needs finite/NaN input validation before adoption.
Media/capture COM surface wrappers do not implement System.Runtime.WindowsRuntime for CLR. No PBI media/capture failure demonstrated.
Power BI refresh/rendering is not Premiere/After Effects media export; substantial new driver/API surface without a product scenario.
Product ships DXVK D3D11 rather than this D3D12/CUDA media pipeline.
